files.name: motion-prompt-076.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Pinning" (ピン留め), one of the names in "Landing page & web effects".
Motion Prompt #076

What it is: A section stays fixed while scrolling advances its content
What the sample shows: A navy section stops when it fills the view; further scrolling steps the number and photo through 1→2→3, then the section scrolls on.
Spec:
- Scroll: 0→500 px at 0.3–3.0 s, 500→0 at 3.5–4.5 s (cubic ease-in-out).
- The section (168 tall, navy) reaches the top at 110 px of scroll and stays there for the next 300 px (a GSAP ScrollTrigger pin).
- Progress while pinned: p = (scroll − 110) / 300. A vertical line (124 long) on the left fills in orange with p.
- At p = 1/3 and 2/3 (±0.07, cubic ease-in-out) it moves to the next step: the number (46 px) rolls up 52 px and the photo (226 × 124) slides up 124 px.
- After 300 px the pin is released and the section scrolls up with the white section below it.
When to use it: Use it to walk through steps, features or a before/after in one screen.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/076.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/lp.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
